## Pull request overview

This PR addresses CI failures caused by a corrupted `pnpm-lock.yaml` by regenerating the lockfile and updating release notes. It also updates auto-generated API reference docs to include the API events schema page.

**Changes:**
- Regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml` to resolve `ERR_PNPM_BROKEN_LOCKFILE` failures during `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`.
- Updated the changelog to document the lockfile fix.
- Updated/added auto-generated API reference docs for `events` (and extended metadata plugin reference content).

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Regenerated lockfile to fix YAML stream corruption and restore frozen-lockfile installs. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Added an Unreleased “Fixed” entry documenting the lockfile regeneration and CI impact. |
| content/docs/references/api/metadata-plugin.mdx | Updated generated API reference page; added `MetadataEvent` section and adjusted TypeScript usage snippet. |
| content/docs/references/api/events.mdx | New generated API reference page for event schemas/types. |
| content/docs/references/api/meta.json | Added `events` to the API reference navigation. |
| content/docs/references/api/index.mdx | Added an “Events” card linking to the new reference page. |
</details>

The PR description claims the regenerated lockfile "maintains all existing dependencies and versions", but the new lockfile clearly changes resolved versions (e.g. React 19.2.4 → 19.2.5 in this hunk, plus other patch bumps elsewhere). Please either update the PR description/CHANGELOG to acknowledge these version bumps or re-run the lockfile regeneration in a way that preserves the previous resolution set if that was the intent.

The TypeScript usage snippet imports `MetadataBulkRegisterRequest` / `MetadataEvent` as runtime values and then calls `.parse(...)`, but the spec exports `MetadataBulkRegisterRequestSchema` / `MetadataEventSchema` as the Zod schemas (and `MetadataEvent` is a type). This snippet as written won’t typecheck and is misleading in the generated docs. The docs generator should emit the correct `*Schema` imports and only use `import type` for the inferred TS types (with aliases if needed).

The TypeScript usage snippet imports `DataEvent` as a runtime value and calls `DataEvent.parse(data)`, but the spec exports `DataEventSchema` as the Zod schema and `DataEvent` only as a TypeScript type. Also, importing the same names in both value and `import type` statements is redundant/confusing. Please update the generator/output to import `DataEventSchema` for parsing and (optionally) `import type { DataEvent }` for the inferred type.

The PR description focuses on regenerating `pnpm-lock.yaml` + updating the changelog, but this diff also adds new API reference docs pages/entries for `events` (meta.json + index.mdx + new events.mdx, plus metadata-plugin.mdx updates). If these doc changes are intentional, please call them out in the PR description; otherwise consider splitting them into a separate docs PR to keep the lockfile-fix change scoped.
